title: refactor: simplify text request and response adapters
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the fake Express request adapter with typed chat and simple-text projections.
- Consolidates message compatibility repairs into one pure pass while preserving provider-specific fields.
- Normalizes request options once at the provider-pipeline boundary instead of in both the route projection and transport client.
- Preserves every upstream choice and response extension without mutating upstream objects.
- Keeps existing seed, JSON, streaming, schema-validation, error, and billing behavior.
- Strips only private usage fields and emits missing created values in epoch seconds.

Production source: 126 net lines removed.

Checks:
- Gen TypeScript typecheck
- Full Gen suite before the follow-up: 1,251 passed, 6 skipped
- Focused request/client/provider suites after the follow-up: 43 passed
- Biome and diff checks

gist.headline: Adapters shed their exoskeleton
gist.blurb: The text pipeline got a quieter, smaller set of moving parts. Polli swept the duplicate normalization out of the garden without disturbing seeds, streams, schemas, or billing.
gist.summary: Refactored the text-generation request and response adapters to use typed chat/simple-text projections, perform message repairs and option normalization once at the provider boundary, preserve provider extensions, and emit missing `created` timestamps in epoch seconds.
gist.impact: Text API behavior for seeds, JSON mode, streaming, schema validation, errors, and billing stays intact while providers receive a cleaner, non-mutating request path and clients retain upstream response extensions.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny gardener's tool belt, carefully combines several tangled API pipes into one clean watering line feeding code-plants. A friendly CRT monitor robot watches a terminal preserve labeled seed packets, JSON scrolls, streaming droplets, and response flowers, representing compatibility retained while duplicate adapter layers are removed.
